headline: The five largest trade union confederations reject the current form of the Salary Law draft: The new version continues to operate with compromise solutions
summary: Romania's five largest trade union confederations said the current Salary Law draft cannot serve as a basis for reform. They demand the draft be withdrawn and the reform restarted from scratch.
why: Public-sector pay law changes affect the state wage bill and budget planning in Romania, a major EU economy.
